decisions.reason: Distant from the firm's established offer and without evidence of meeting aspirations, it likely falls short and triggers problemistic search, leading to a high chance of dropping.
Building on the established industrial lighting offer, it aligns with core capabilities and likely meets or exceeds aspirations, so the firm keeps it.
Close to the established offer and a relaunch of a popular product, it likely performs near or above aspirations, so the firm keeps it.
Close to the established office lighting offer and fitting existing expertise, it is likely to meet aspirations, and slack allows keeping it as it establishes.
Close to the established premium lighting offer and sold as a product line, it likely meets aspirations and benefits from synergies, so the firm keeps it.
